what.text: This page follows people displaced inside China by disasters; IDMC's data has no conflict displacement for China.
In 2025 IDMC recorded 3501695 new displacements from disasters, a yearly count of movements rather than people.
Refugees from China live mainly in India and the United States.

why.text: Earthquakes, floods, mass movements, storms and wildfires are the disasters recorded for China in IDMC's data.
The sources here don't say which disasters caused the largest displacements in each year.

when.text: IDMC's highest yearly figure for new disaster displacements is for 2008, at 18659649.
The largest change in the year-end figures came between 2020 and 2021.

how.text: IDMC reports the number of people still displaced by disasters at year end only for some years; it fell from 942638 in 2021 to 639183 in 2023.
A new-displacement figure counts each forced move, so one person can be counted more than once.
